### Release Notes

<details>
<summary>opencontainers/cgroups (github.com/opencontainers/cgroups)</summary>

### [`v0.1.1`](https://redirect.github.com/opencontainers/cgroups/releases/tag/v0.1.1)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/opencontainers/cgroups/compare/v0.1.0...v0.1.1)

This release concludes the removal of cilium/ebpf dependency started in v0.1.0 (it is only used by tests now), tightens the CI and release workflows (zizmor, actionlint, immutable tags), and adds a few fixes and enhancements to fs and systemd cgroup drivers.

#### What's Changed

- ci: use latest golangci-lint by [@​kolyshkin](https://redirect.github.com/kolyshkin) in [#​77](https://redirect.github.com/opencontainers/cgroups/pull/77)
- systemd: support zswap unified resources by [@​MKrupauskas](https://redirect.github.com/MKrupauskas) in [#​76](https://redirect.github.com/opencontainers/cgroups/pull/76)
- build(deps): bump github.com/cilium/ebpf from 0.17.3 to 0.22.0 by [@​dependabot](https://redirect.github.com/dependabot)\[bot] in [#​80](https://redirect.github.com/opencontainers/cgroups/pull/80)
- build(deps): bump github.com/sirupsen/logrus to v1.10.2 by [@​kolyshkin](https://redirect.github.com/kolyshkin) in [#​81](https://redirect.github.com/opencontainers/cgroups/pull/81)
- systemd: use sync.WaitGroup.Go in TestParallelConnection by [@​kolyshkin](https://redirect.github.com/kolyshkin) in [#​82](https://redirect.github.com/opencontainers/cgroups/pull/82)
- systemd: fix jitter in dbus connection retry backoff by [@​hakman](https://redirect.github.com/hakman) in [#​85](https://redirect.github.com/opencontainers/cgroups/pull/85)
- fs: initialize subsystems lazily by [@​kolyshkin](https://redirect.github.com/kolyshkin) in [#​90](https://redirect.github.com/opencontainers/cgroups/pull/90)
- ci: add zizmor and actionlint, harden workflows by [@​kolyshkin](https://redirect.github.com/kolyshkin) in [#​83](https://redirect.github.com/opencontainers/cgroups/pull/83)
- fs: fix hugetlb tests by [@​kolyshkin](https://redirect.github.com/kolyshkin) in [#​87](https://redirect.github.com/opencontainers/cgroups/pull/87)
- fs2: support OwnerUID by [@​kolyshkin](https://redirect.github.com/kolyshkin) in [#​84](https://redirect.github.com/opencontainers/cgroups/pull/84)
- systemd: DetectUID: use $ROOTLESSKIT_PARENT_EUID if set by [@​kolyshkin](https://redirect.github.com/kolyshkin) in [#​88](https://redirect.github.com/opencontainers/cgroups/pull/88)
- Relax PR merge rules, enforce them via CI by [@​kolyshkin](https://redirect.github.com/kolyshkin) in [#​91](https://redirect.github.com/opencontainers/cgroups/pull/91)
- ci: re-pin kjanat/actionlint to the current v1.17 by [@​kolyshkin](https://redirect.github.com/kolyshkin) in [#​95](https://redirect.github.com/opencontainers/cgroups/pull/95)
- dependabot: fix ignore rule for review-policy.yml by [@​kolyshkin](https://redirect.github.com/kolyshkin) in [#​97](https://redirect.github.com/opencontainers/cgroups/pull/97)
- build(deps): bump zizmorcore/zizmor-action from 0.8.0 to 0.8.1 by [@​dependabot](https://redirect.github.com/dependabot)\[bot] in [#​93](https://redirect.github.com/opencontainers/cgroups/pull/93)
- systemd: fix CPU quota overflow and unified cpu.max round-up by [@​kolyshkin](https://redirect.github.com/kolyshkin) in [#​79](https://redirect.github.com/opencontainers/cgroups/pull/79)
- devices: drop cilium/ebpf/asm dependency by [@​mfrw](https://redirect.github.com/mfrw) in [#​94](https://redirect.github.com/opencontainers/cgroups/pull/94)
- Skip cgroup tests when no cgroups are mounted by [@​kolyshkin](https://redirect.github.com/kolyshkin) in [#​99](https://redirect.github.com/opencontainers/cgroups/pull/99)
- systemd/v2: set MemorySwapMax=0 when disabling swap by [@​kolyshkin](https://redirect.github.com/kolyshkin) in [#​78](https://redirect.github.com/opencontainers/cgroups/pull/78)

#### New Contributors

- [@​MKrupauskas](https://redirect.github.com/MKrupauskas) made their first contribution in [#​76](https://redirect.github.com/opencontainers/cgroups/pull/76)
- [@​hakman](https://redirect.github.com/hakman) made their first contribution in [#​85](https://redirect.github.com/opencontainers/cgroups/pull/85)
- [@​mfrw](https://redirect.github.com/mfrw) made their first contribution in [#​94](https://redirect.github.com/opencontainers/cgroups/pull/94)

**Full Changelog**: <https://github.com/opencontainers/cgroups/compare/v0.1.0...v0.1.1>
